briefdescription.para: Phase 4 memory safety and bounds checking tests (MS-01..MS-20).

detaileddescription.para: Verifies pointer arithmetic bounds checking, buffer overflow prevention, iterator invalidation prevention, and span-based safe access.

sect2.title: Test families
sect2.para: MS-01 Pointer arithmetic within allocated range succeeds MS-02 Pointer arithmetic beyond end rejected MS-03 Negative offset underflow detection MS-04 Null pointer detection before dereference MS-05 Pointer validation on aggregation paths
MS-06 Write within buffer bounds succeeds MS-07 Write beyond buffer bounds detected MS-08 Buffer reallocation preserves data MS-09 Stack buffer overflow detection MS-10 Heap corruption detection
MS-11 Iterator valid after non-modifying operation MS-12 Iterator invalid after vector reallocation MS-13 Iterator valid after const reference access

MS-14 Span construction from vector preserves bounds MS-15 Span access within bounds succeeds MS-16 Span out-of-bounds access prevented MS-17 Span subspan maintains bounds checking MS-18 Span empty() correctly handles zero-length spans
MS-19 RAII lifecycle prevents use-after-free MS-20 Copy-on-write semantics prevent memory corruption
